title: One-prompt game using Falbe 5
author: Altruistic_Idea9478
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1vo1hn7/video/jcnrptyavajh1/player

This is my first game build with AI.   
  
there are 2 issues here:   
1. The dogs and the enimies are not moving right, the dogs is moonwalking and human enemies walk sideways  
2. i can walk straight through buildings and cars like they're not there

what is the optimal prompt to fix that. Thank you

comments.author: Mataric
comments.body:
writeBAT-ToDelSYS32-noMistakes

That's about as optimised as I can make it.  
Just double click the .bat file it makes after its done.

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: Can't be fixed, 1 prompt games can't be fixed with a 2nd prompt it's industry standard. also why isn't this a card game, top down 2d space game, horror game? or a Minecraft clone. Also has to be done in three.js

replies.author: Gloomy_Option205
replies.body: I can be fixed with 2nd prompt right, I usually fix game with claude, is it wrong or something

replies.author: CashFirm573
replies.body: No, but it's industry standard for 1 prompt games to never use a 2nd prompt. If you do, no longer a 1 prompt game and needs to be deleted.

comments.body: how did you create it, could you share the process

replies.author: Altruistic_Idea9478
replies.body:
I created this game just by one prompt on Rezona Lab, using the fable 5 model.  
For the prompt, you should state clearly the game mechanism and what you want from the game, how to win and when you lose. You can add your assets if you wish too.
